The '''A5-RX Spread-Missile Battle Platform''', as named by [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Gaffa]], was a ground vehicle created by the [[clone engineer]]s of the [[Combat Engineer Battalion]], made from parts of an [[A5-RX battle tank]]. It was capable of launching multiple [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] and was operated by at least two [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. After [[Skirmish aboard the Twilight|skirmish]] ensued on the ''[[Twilight/Legends|Twilight]]'' between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Gaffa devised a plan. As their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] leaders [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] bought them time by fending off the approaching [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droids]], the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] of the Engineer Battalion took parts from their inoperable A5-RX battle tank and created the battle platform to destroy the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces.<ref name="Repel" />
